name: Capital Management Manager
description: Oversees capital and expense management activities across the Finance & Investments value stream, anchoring long-range planning and dividend management. Directs cost reduction program management and expense policy governance, sizing savings opportunities and defining initiative parameters. Produces expense analytics reporting, CFO expense packs, and variance commentary through the ERP and enterprise data warehouse.

name: Capital Model Actuary
description: Performs capital and reserve modeling within the Actuarial value stream, constructing risk correlation matrices and incorporating stress outcomes into ORSA and ICAAP. Delivers reserve development monitoring, prior-year development analysis, and actuarial triangle construction on actuarial modeling platforms. Supports board actuarial reporting and the statutory actuarial opinion, archiving assumptions in the governance register.

name: Cash Application Specialist
description: Performs billing and receivables processing within the Business Operations value stream, handling withdrawal processing, policy loans, and reinstatements on the policy administration system. Executes nondiscrimination testing and plan installation duties, validating census data and filing Form 5500 via EFAST2. Confirms AML documentation meets BSA requirements and supports plan audit adjustments.

name: Cash Management Analyst
description: Performs daily cash positioning and liquidity management within the Finance & Investments value stream, sweeping surplus cash and aggregating available liquidity across entities. Executes payments under dual-authorization controls, screens outbound payments against sanctions lists, and resolves cash reconciliation breaks. Runs liquidity stress testing and reports results to ALCO and finance leadership.

name: Catastrophe & Exposure Manager
description: Oversees catastrophe exposure and placement activities within the Reinsurance value stream, driving retrocession structuring and net-retention setting. Manages assumed exposure data ingestion and contract wording through slip finalization and signed-wording storage. Prepares and presents reinsurance governance committee packs and coordinates reinsurance regulatory reporting with compliance and audit.

name: Ceded Reinsurance Analyst
description: Performs ceded placement support within the Reinsurance value stream, preparing and submitting recovery billing statements to reinsurers. Supports retrocession structuring and net-retention setting, analyzing market conditions and distributing management MI to stakeholders. Contributes to reinsurance regulatory reporting and governance committee work, triaging assumed loss advices and confirming cedant reporting compliance.

name: Change Coordinator
description: Coordinates learning and licensing operations within the Human Resources & Talent value stream, publishing approved content to the LMS and assigning learning paths. Administers mandatory training compliance and certification tracking, mapping requirements to frameworks and updating materials as regulations change. Supports producer licensing by reporting CE compliance status and flagging licenses at risk of lapse.

name: Change Management Specialist
description: Leads organizational change activities within the Program Management Office value stream, conducting change impact assessments and readiness baselines. Builds stakeholder engagement and communications plans, mapping affected stakeholders and assessing ADKAR readiness. Drives adoption measurement and sustainability, delivering refresher training to low-proficiency teams and producing adoption completion reports for benefits tracking.

name: Channel Operations Coordinator
description: Coordinates distribution operations within the Sales, Distribution & Marketing value stream, supporting agency and broker relationship governance and delegated authority oversight. Maintains producer pipeline support by logging bound submissions in the CRM and updating forecasts. Tracks corrective actions to completion, obtains compliance sign-off on partner materials, and produces customer insights and retention cross-sell analytics.

name: Chief Actuary
description: Owns the actuarial function across the Actuarial value stream, accountable for the statutory actuarial opinion and board actuarial reporting. Directs reserve development monitoring, prior-year development analysis, and actuarial rating methodology on actuarial modeling platforms. Responds to Board and Audit Committee questions and incorporates stress outcomes into ORSA and ICAAP.

name: Chief Audit Executive
description: Owns risk-based audit planning across the Risk, Compliance & Audit value stream, directing compliance testing and market conduct examination support. Oversees control deficiency management, validating closure evidence and re-testing remediated controls for effectiveness. Governs regulatory change management and key risk indicator monitoring through the GRC platform, tracking examination corrective actions to completion.

name: Chief Claims Officer
description: Owns claims operations across the Claims value stream, directing claims workflow routing, liability evaluation, and ongoing claim management. Oversees denial management and release agreement handling, ensuring decisions are documented and appeals tracked in the claims platform. Governs vendor network management and structured settlement placement, rebalancing misrouted claims and monitoring routing exceptions.

name: Chief Data Officer
description: Owns enterprise data and AI strategy across the Data & AI value stream, directing AI use case framing, incident management, and FinOps governance. Governs model risk management, tracking validation findings to remediation closure and submitting model-use filings to state regulators. Shapes analytics requirements and predictive rating model development on the data warehouse and model governance repository.
